answer: Standing is a ledge that only holds when a stranger tries to push you off it: each epoch’s work must survive a challenge by an established stranger who tries to disprove it — a timber only stands when a stranger tries to knock it down, and an ocean only counts when it survives being drained. A farm of a thousand fakes collapses at the first real challenge: their work is fake, so it cannot survive being disproved, and one epoch of unchallenged work adds nothing.
